music.base: 16-bit Super Nintendo (SNES) fighting game music in the style of mid-90s arcade ports, SPC700 sampled instruments, warm stereo echo, punchy sampled drums, loopable ending, instrumental only, no vocals.

tracks.title: Title screen anthem. B-flat major, 128 BPM. Brass fanfare over orchestra hits and a driving marching snare, heroic and triumphant. [0:00] fanfare intro [0:15] main theme [0:45] bridge [1:15] reprise.
tracks.select: Character select screen loop. F major, 116 BPM, light swing. Slap bass, marimba lead, electric piano offbeats, playful and bouncy.
tracks.fable: Stage theme for a stoic, restrained titan who is secretly the most powerful fighter. D minor, 138 BPM. Soaring strings and French horn melody, harpsichord arpeggios, noble and heroic like a 16-bit RPG hero theme.
tracks.opus: Stage theme for an elegant orchestra conductor. G minor, 150 BPM. A baroque-era fugue with strict counterpoint turned into a fighting game battle theme: harpsichord lead, pizzicato strings, walking bass, timpani.
tracks.astra: Stage theme for a slow, godlike cosmic emperor at a desert data center at sunset. C minor, 120 BPM. Choir pads, pipe organ, huge tom drums, bell arpeggios, epic and ominous.
tracks.sol: Stage theme for a fast, sunny, cheerful sprinter at a product launch livestream. E major, 160 BPM. Synth-funk with slap bass, clavinet, brass stabs, bright pulse-wave lead.
tracks.grok: Stage theme for a swaggering rebel brawler at an industrial supercomputer site at night. E minor, 170 BPM. Distorted guitar metal, palm-muted power chord chugs, double kick drum, siren synth lead.
tracks.gemini: Stage theme for a hyper-fast, anxious speedster at a tech keynote amphitheater. F-sharp minor, 160 BPM. Frantic eurobeat with supersaw lead, square-wave arpeggios, four-on-the-floor kick.
tracks.deepseek: Stage theme for a calm, frugal martial-arts monk at West Lake, Hangzhou at night. D minor pentatonic, 110 BPM. Guzheng plucks, erhu lead with vibrato, bamboo flute, taiko drums, big echo.
tracks.qwen: Stage theme for a hyperactive shapeshifter at a neon Singles' Day night market. C major pentatonic, 170 BPM. Festive hyper-pop: bright square lead, marimba arpeggios, gongs, fast hi-hats.
tracks.kimi: Stage theme for a giant moon ninja on the lunar surface. B minor, 128 BPM. Spacey synthwave with analog bass, lush pads, bell arpeggios, very long echo, lonely and huge.
tracks.mythos: Final boss theme for an unsealed, forbidden AI in an opened vault. C-sharp minor, 100 BPM. Cathedral pipe organ, low choir, pedal bass, ominous bells, dread building to a climax.
tracks.victory: Short 6-second victory jingle. C major, 140 BPM. Brass fanfare with a snare roll and a final sustained chord. No loop.
